We are grateful to the many research associates and research interns who have contributed to ODEKA's work over the years. This page is also where past and current ODEKA personnel can find each other again — if you worked with us and would like your entry updated, reach out to [odeka.webmaster@gmail.com](mailto:odeka.webmaster@gmail.com).
